HOW IT WORKS
From URL to actionable report in under a minute

No setup, no signup. Paste a website URL or a listing from one of seven supported stores — we render it, score it across six categories, and rank what to fix first.

01
Paste a URL

Drop in any public homepage, landing page, pricing page, App Store or Google Play listing, Chrome Web Store extension, Shopify App Store app, GitHub repository, Notion template, or GPT Store listing. We auto-detect the type and render it in a real headless browser, JavaScript and all.

02
AI runs the analysis

Six categories — UX, content, performance, accessibility, SEO, and conversion — against a structured rubric, with the rubric reframed for the platform: ASO for app stores, install-conversion for Chrome and Shopify, README and star-conversion for GitHub repos, listing optimization for Notion templates and GPT Store agents.

03
Review prioritized fixes

Get an overall score, per-category breakdowns, strengths and weaknesses, and recommendations tagged critical, high, medium, or low. Export as PDF or re-audit later to track progress.

WHAT GETS SCORED
Six categories, one consistent rubric

A 0–100 score per category, with example findings drawn from the rendered page. Every supported listing type uses the same six categories, with SEO reframed as the right kind of optimization for the platform — ASO for mobile app stores, install conversion for Chrome and Shopify, star and clone conversion for GitHub READMEs, listing optimization for Notion templates and the GPT Store.

UX

Information hierarchy, task clarity, navigation, and visual structure.

EXAMPLE FINDING

"The hero buries the primary action under three lines of marketing copy — pull the URL form above the value prop."

Content

Copy clarity, depth, audience fit, and how well the page explains itself.

EXAMPLE FINDING

"~990 words but most of it restates the rubric. Replace with concrete example findings and outcome metrics."

Performance

Load behavior, page weight, and signals that affect perceived speed.

EXAMPLE FINDING

"286 KB response, 9.7s fetch — 8 scripts on a no-image landing page is too heavy. Defer non-critical JS."

Accessibility

Semantic structure, image alt coverage, language attributes, and form labeling.

EXAMPLE FINDING

"lang attribute set, viewport correct, 0 missing alts (no images). URL form is missing a persistent visible label."

SEO

Title, meta, canonical, headings, Open Graph, JSON-LD, and content depth.
